why: Real schemas, not written by this project. A hand-written corpus would only contain the constructs its author remembered to handle, which measures agreement rather than accuracy. The files are fetched on purpose and are not committed: they are large, they belong to their projects, and the URL is the durable part.

schemas.name: synapse
schemas.notes: Matrix homeserver. ~134 tables, modest use of CHECK.

schemas.name: gitlab
schemas.notes: ~955 tables and 2,537 CHECK expressions. The schema that showed the refuse-every-CHECK policy was too blunt to be useful.
